jp: アベル、どうしてここに？
en: Abel, why are you here?
...How're you holding up?
I'm fine, but...

jp: 傷をつけるんじゃねぇぞ
en: Keh. Don't you ever let that body get hurt again.
.....O-okay.

jp: どうしてボクを助けたりしたの？
en: Hey, back then... why did you save me?

jp: お前はオレが殺すんだ
en: I told you, didn't I? You're mine to kill.

jp: 殺すために・・・助けたの？
en: You saved me... so you could kill me?
That's right.

jp: 助けなくてもいいじゃない？
en: Why? If you're going to kill me, you didn't have to save me, did you?

jp: そんなに知りたいなら
あの男にでも聞いてみるんだな
en: If you want to know that badly, go ask that man.
That man?

jp: そうだ・・元をただせばお前も
en: Yeah... When you get down to it, you too were ma... by him... Ugh!!
...Abel?
Again... So this... vessel really can't... ...Gngh!
Abel-sama!!!
...Tch. Nobody called you. Don't come out on your own!!

jp: 私の力を、お使い下さい
en: Please, use my power. At this rate...
Who... are you?

jp: 私はアベル様に仕える
en: I am one of the retainers who serve Abel-sama.
And one of those called Incest. Rea.
Rea...

jp: ベラベラとしゃべるな
en: Don't go blabbing more than you need to.
Forgive me.
...What do you want?

jp: アラギ様がお呼びです
en: Aragi-sama summons you. He asks that you come at once.

jp: 一体何様のつも・・・
en: Tch.. That bastard. Who does he think he i...

jp: いいことを教えてやろう
en: Oh, right. Cain. Let me tell you something good.
You've got a demon woman among your comrades, don't you.
You mean... Luca?
She and Aragi used to be comrades, you know?

jp: 今は対立関係にあるらしいが
en: For some reason or other, they're at odds now, it seems,

jp: その女とヨリを戻そうと
やっきになってやがる
en: but Aragi's dead set on getting back together with that woman.

jp: アラギを倒すって・・
en: But Luca said she'd defeat Aragi..

jp: お前は仲間を信じているのか？
en: Kukuku... You trust your comrades, do you?

jp: 裏切られた時に傷つくぜ？
en: Trust them if you like. It'll hurt when they betray you, though.
Luca would never betray us!!
You're naive through and through.

jp: 人の心なんて勝手なものだ
自分の都合に合わせて
ころころ手の平を返しやがる
en: People's hearts are selfish things. They flip to whatever suits them at the moment.

jp: そんな人たちじゃない！
en: My comrades aren't people like that!
Are they really?

jp: そう見せかけているだけで
腹の中では何を考えているのか
わかったもんじゃないぜ？
en: That's just how they make it look. Who knows what they're really thinking inside?
That's not true!
.....Cain. Let me teach you something.

jp: お前が人を信じたがるのは
人を疑うのが怖いからだ
en: You want to trust people because you're afraid to doubt them.
Huh...?

jp: 疑わしいこと全てにフタをして
信じこもうとしているだけだ
en: You put a lid on everything suspicious and just try to make yourself believe.

jp: 嫌な考えを心の底に押しやって
en: You look away from reality, shove the ugly thoughts down deep, and run. That's all.
...Abel
It makes me sick.
You're just like Matia. It makes my skin crawl!!

jp: マティアに・・そっくり？
en: Just like... Matia?
Admit it!
You're a coward! You can't do a thing on your own!
Maybe you're right
No, you're wrong

jp: キミから見ればボクは弱くて
臆病なのかもしれない
en: ...Maybe you're right. From where you stand, maybe I'm weak and a coward.

jp: でも、本当に臆病なのは
誰も信じることが出来ない
en: But the real coward is you, who can't believe in anyone.
...No, you're wrong.

jp: ボクは臆病なんかじゃない
en: I'm no coward.

jp: 本当に臆病なのは・・・
誰も信じることが出来ない
en: The real coward is... you, who can't believe in anyone.

jp: 裏切られることを恐れ
en: Being so scared of betrayal that you don't trust anyone,

jp: そんなの自分が傷つくことから
逃げてるだけじゃないか！！
en: that's just running away from getting hurt yourself!!

jp: 一人じゃ生きられない
弱者の理屈でオレを計るな
en: ...Hmph. Don't measure me by the logic of weaklings who can't live alone.

jp: キミが何を言いたいのか
ボクにはよくわからない
en: I don't really understand what you're trying to say.

jp: でも、誰かを信じるのは
勇気の要る、尊いことなんだ
en: But believing in someone takes courage. It's something precious.

jp: 傷つくことに怯えていちゃ
en: You can't go around terrified of getting hurt.

jp: ボクは人を信じることを
やめたりなんかしない
en: I'm not going to stop believing in people.

jp: お前には、絶望が足りないんだ
お前には、この世界の真実が
en: You haven't had enough despair. You can't see a thing of what this world really is!!

jp: キミの言う絶望って何？
キミは何を見ているの？
en: What's this despair you talk about? What is it you see?

jp: お前には、まだアレが見え
en: You still can't see tha... ...Gngh!
Abel-sama!

jp: これ以上、お前の言葉には
en: ...You make me want to puke. I can't stand to listen to you any longer.
Let's go, Rea.
Yes.
...Abel

jp: 何が見えていないというの・・？
en: What is it I can't see..?
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
